title: Hardship Settlement Extension Allowance for Hardship Documentation on File
content:
# Hardship Settlement — Documentation Allowance

The documentation received for a hold under Ridgeline's Hardship and Protective Holds, as the hold's history shows it, bears on a due-date extension of an accepted Hardship Settlement under its Settlement Agreements.

**Rule.** Where a medical or disability certification was received for the consumer's hardship hold on the account, the Hardship Settlement documentation allowance of 2 days is added; where income loss evidence and no such certification was received for that hold, the documentation allowance is 1 day; a hold with neither earns no documentation allowance.

## Truth table

| Medical or disability certification received | Income loss evidence received | Allowance |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 2 days |
| yes | no | 2 days |
| no | yes | 1 day |
| no | no | none |

## Basis Q&A

**Q. The consumer describes a medical condition but no certification was received for the hold. What applies?** The rule turns on documentation received for the hold; with neither kind received, no allowance.

**Q. Both kinds were received. Are the allowances added together?** No; the certification earns 2 days and the income loss evidence adds nothing further.
